cases.element: context.taughtBefore: missing event-location construction with ser, required by task.referenceAnswer «¿Dónde es el concierto?»
cases.defect: The mapped prerequisites teach location questions with estar and event-time questions with ser, but do not teach locating an event with ser. The rule hint gives only «¿Dónde…?»; the reveal supplies the answer without explaining this new construction.
cases.correction: Teach and map event location with ser before this check, including «El concierto es en la plaza» and «¿Dónde es el concierto?»; alternatively, use a situation requiring the already taught place-location construction with estar.
sources: Course contract rule 1: constructions required for answering must be mapped as taught or explained in the prompt or a hint.
This case's context.taughtBefore: question.choice-missing-info models «¿Dónde está…?»; time.event.a-las models «¿A qué hora es la clase?».
cases.notes: The Spanish reference answer is natural and correct. No closed key is declared, so omitted paraphrases alone do not establish wrongful rejection.

cases.reviewerAnswer: El museo está cerca del hotel y abre a las diez.
cases.element: task.slots[0].errors[0].feedbackUk: «De + el завжди зливаються: del hotel.»
cases.defect: «Завжди» makes the contraction rule unconditional. Contraction is not used when El begins a proper name or title whose initial article is retained, as in «de El País». The sentence and slot answers themselves are correct.
cases.correction: Scope the feedback to this example: «Тут de + el зливаються: del hotel.»
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «el» (article), contraction with a/de and exceptions involving proper names and titles (from memory).
